name: release-announcement
description: Turn a version section of CHANGELOG.md (or a pasted changelog) into the team's version-release announcement, with Jira links and deduped tickets. Use when the user asks for a "release message", "release announcement", "version X was released", or pastes changelog text.

# Release announcement

Produces the message we post after a version is released to `dev` and `uat`. The user pastes it into dillinger.io, so the output is markdown inside a plain code block.

## CHANGELOG.md format (generated by semantic-release, do not edit by hand)

```
# [11.39.0](https://dev.azure.com/.../compare/v11.38.0...v11.39.0) (2026-10-19)


### Bug Fixes

* **anc:** baggage ui codeshare/interline [RUN-37175] ([fc4ac00](https://dev.azure.com/.../commit/fc4ac00...))

### Features

* **core:** ibe search tool [RUN-24330] ([5d3db38](https://dev.azure.com/.../commit/5d3db38...))
```

- Heading is `#` for minor/major versions and `##` for patch versions. Both are valid.
- `-rc.N` sections are pre-releases. The final version section (no `-rc`) already contains every entry from its rc sections, so use the final section alone when it exists.
- Each entry line is: `* **<scope>:** <message> [RUN-<ticket>] ([<hash>](<commit url>))`.

## Steps

1. **Find the version.** From the user's text, or the newest section in `CHANGELOG.md` whose heading has no `-rc`. If the user asks for a version that only has rc sections so far, collect every `-rc` section since the previous final version and say that the final section does not exist yet.
2. **Extract entries** from that section with the pattern above: scope, message, ticket. Ignore the hash and commit link.
3. **Dedupe by ticket.** Keep the first line per `RUN-xxxxx`. List the dropped tickets to the user after the message. (Dupes happen when rc sections are combined, e.g. `11.39.1` and `11.39.1-rc.1` both list RUN-37175.)
4. **Map the scope** to its display name:

   | changelog scope | display |
   |---|---|
   | `anc`, `ancillaries` | Ancillaries |
   | `mmb` | MMB |
   | `core` | Core |
   | `flights`, `flights-ui` | Flights |
   | `search`, `search-ui` | Search |
   | `slider` | Slider |
   | `ui` | UI |
   | `passengers` | Passengers |
   | anything else | Capitalise the first letter |

5. **Link the ticket**: `[RUN-12345](https://elalweb.atlassian.net/browse/RUN-12345)`. Keep the message text exactly as written in the changelog.
6. **Build the message** with the template below. Features first, then Bug Fixes. Skip a group with no entries.
7. Output the message in one plain code block, then one line naming the deduped tickets (or "No duplicate tickets").

## Template

```
Hi all!

Version {X.Y.Z} has been released and is available in branches dev and uat.

It consists of the following:

**Features**
- **MMB:** refresh seat map for eligible lower prices [RUN-37648](https://elalweb.atlassian.net/browse/RUN-37648)

**Bug Fixes**
- **Ancillaries:** baggage tooltip flicker on remove [RUN-38026](https://elalweb.atlassian.net/browse/RUN-38026)

Indra, please request a promotion to uat.

Thanks!
```

## Rules

- Never include commit hashes, commit links, or the compare link.
- Never rephrase an entry; only the scope is transformed.
- Always end with "Indra, please request a promotion to uat." followed by "Thanks!".
- Ask for the version only when it cannot be derived from the changelog or the user's message.
